PC: Ask for intravenous (IV) access, to have patient placed on monitor, call for nasal cannula
Promptly perform focused History and Physical Exam
Discover complaints of chest pain and diaphoresis and radiating pain
Give 325 mg of oral aspirin and consider medications such as nitroglycerin after confirming normal blood pressure
Order appropriate labs: troponin, CBC, BMP, coagulation panel
Feel for pulse and ask for cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) to commence upon discovering no pulse
Ask for defibrillator and defibrillate patient
Continue CPR with pulse and rhythm checks every 2 minutes
Give 1mg of (1:10,000) IV epinephrine every 3-5 minutes
Once patient has return of spontaneous circulation, stop CPR
MK: Recognize ST elevations in leads V2-V6, I and aVL and reciprocal ST depression in leads II, III, aVF
Look at monitor and correctly diagnose Vfib arrest
SBP: Describe case succinctly and send patient to catheterization lab
ICS: The learner will take lead and assign clear roles
